newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar prices end lower on higher supplies.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar prices end lower on higher supplies.

text.p: Indian sugar prices ended lower on Thursday on higher offerings, dealers said.

They said fresh physical demand remained sluggish despite expected festival demand. In the ready delivery sugar S-30 fell by 14/35 rupees to 1,291/1,325 rupees per quintal while M-30 fell by 10/25 rupees to 1,320/1,375 rupees. Sugar mill delivery fell by 10 rupees to 1,225/1,245 rupees.
"Outstation demand at the mill level is easing out and millers are offering more sugar in the local market," one broker said. Overall market sentiment remained subdued at the close.
